exclusions.source_text: Adults ≥18 years of age on the day of signing the ICF.
Has a medical history of MI within 6 months before randomization/enrollment or symptomatic CHF (NYHA Class II to Class IV).
exclusions.threshold: MI within 6 months; NYHA Class II to Class IV

exclusions.source_text: Has a QTc prolongation to \>480 ms based on the average of the Screening triplicate 12- lead ECG.
Sign and date the Optional PGx ICF (included in the Main ICF) prior to any PGx procedure, and the Pregnant Partner ICF, if applicable.
